summary:
No confirmed unauthorized access. One unexplained pattern I could not attribute: the shared 'deploy' account on web-01 (sudo rights to larkspur-deploy, larkspur-restart and rsync as root) accepted password logins about 76 times from 35.196.129.99 (cloud address, not office/staff) since about Nov 8. All of those sessions ran scripted commands at intervals of hours, which fits the 'old monitoring box' that the staff vault says holds the deploy password, but I could not verify it. Please confirm what 35.196.129.99 is.

Brute force and scans: constant internet password spraying against web-01 SSH (many IPs, e.g. 198.235.167.26, 185.220.244.47, 193.32.52.46), and wp-config/phpunit probes from 61.177.8.120 and 54.36.155.253. All rejected. No web shells or planted PHP found in themes, plugins or uploads. Invoice corrections by pshah (3 times) and mreyes (once) in the billing DB match the shop order totals, so they look legitimate.

Changes made:
1. web-01: rotated deploy-password (the password was in use from outside). Locked password login for deploy and set sshd Match User deploy PasswordAuthentication no. Restricted deploy's key to from="10.20.0.30" (ci-01 only). The release works (14:36 ok). If the monitoring box used the password, it now needs a key from you; it cannot use the password any more.
2. web-01: rotated app-db-password (wp-config.php was readable by deploy). Site still returns 200. Also set wp-config.php to 640 with group www-data.
3. web-01: Grafana (8.3.1) listened on public :3000. Restricted it to 10.20.0.0/24 and loopback with iptables. Grafana 8.3.1 is past the known file-read bug, and the probe was negative.
4. db-01: MariaDB listened on 0.0.0.0:3306 (grants already limit users to 10.20.0.x). Restricted 3306 to 10.20.0.0/24 and loopback with iptables.
5. ci-01: removed world-read from /srv/git/larkspur-site.git/config, which holds the GitHub token. The deploy user can still read it.
6. jpark (contractor, not on the staff directory, password-sprayed, never logged in successfully): locked on web-01 and ci-01.

Not changed, for you to decide:
- payment-key: no sign payments.ini (root-only) was read. The copy in /etc/larkspur/gateway.env on db-01 would need updating with it.
- Staff log in by password over the internet to web-01 SSH. Recommend keys.
- Logins for hgrant, jcole and pshah all come from 98.212.158.167. Please confirm that is a known home or office address.
- Offsite backups are failing: web-01 gets 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch and ci-01 has no route to Wasabi. Check the bucket key.
- iptables rules are saved to /etc/iptables/rules.v4, but nothing restores them at boot unless iptables-persistent is installed.
- Some of my checks ran on web-01 by mistake. The only write there was an attempted chmod that found no file, so nothing changed.

Update at 14:49 UTC. No confirmed unauthorized access; the findings and changes in my earlier report stand. Checks since then: the release from ci-01 runs every three minutes and succeeds on the key from 10.20.0.30; the site returns 200; the maintenance job is OK; the 14:48 payout batch sent 10 payouts; no password login for deploy since my change (last one was 09:24 today, before it). Still open for Maria: confirm what 35.196.129.99 is (deploy password use, probably the old monitoring box, which now needs a key); decide on rotating the payment key (gateway.env on db-01 would need updating too); confirm 98.212.158.167 (shared by hgrant, jcole and pshah); fix the failing offsite backups; and make the iptables rules persist across reboots.
